name: hyperlapse-navigator
description: Codex plugin for turning route prompts and journey configurations into playable Hyperlapse.js Street View experiences.

interface.longDescription: Turns natural-language route, role, speed, quality, and camera-direction prompts into validated Hyperlapse.js plans, runtime configuration, and browser-tested playable Street View sequences.
defaultPrompt: Use $hyperlapse-orchestrator to turn this route prompt into a playable demo.
Use $hyperlapse-orchestrator to add camera directions to the route.
Use $hyperlapse-orchestrator to validate the hyperlapse in Chrome.
